confidence_notes: Numbeo's Bergen survey last updated 2026-10-02 gives meal, cappuccino and draft-beer prices; their USD equivalents use the paired NOK/USD hotel figures on BudgetYourTrip. Drink and lodging estimates are less certain: wine and cocktails use Bergen guide/menu prices, hostel comparisons disagree, and hotel estimates smooth reported low- and peak-season prices while allowing for taxes and fees.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparator used; Bergen-specific price and accommodation references were available.
